traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Action meets disruption. Impulsive, risk-taking, rebellious energy, with impatience and a pull toward technology. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Accident-proneness, a temper that goes off like a shot, and unpredictable tactics that either win big or backfire fast. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Drive and disruption reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Innovative and fast; the cost is recklessness and volatility.
shadow: Anger and recklessness collides with instability for its own sake; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.

readerCopy.summary: The person demanding an immediate break faces the people trying to keep a volatile system from collapsing.
readerCopy.body: The person demanding an immediate break faces the people trying to keep a volatile system from collapsing. Mars opposite Uranus can turn a needed change into a standoff over timing, especially when one side sees every delay as complicity and the other sees every abrupt move as another source of damage. The old arrangement may be failing, but the replacement still needs somewhere to land. Name what has to stop now and what must stay functional during the transition. Freedom is easier to defend when the exit plan does not create a second emergency.
